MACOM supply chain single source foundry Taiwan China risk factors 10-K

findings.claim: MACOM 10-K 披露：特定製程晶圓通常僅經單一代工廠取得，並倚賴該廠供應該製程全部晶圓；另述可能對各類材料使用單一供應來源。
findings.excerpt: wafers procured from merchant foundries for a particular process technology are generally sourced through a single foundry on which we rely for all of our wafers in that process.

findings.claim: MACOM 10-K 披露：供應商若原料庫存不足、倒閉、產能受限或暫時停工，公司面臨供應鏈中斷風險；緩解方式為多源認證、改設計、增加庫存。
findings.excerpt: Our reliance on external suppliers puts us at risk of supply chain disruption if a supplier does not have sufficient raw material inventory to meet our manufacturing needs, goes out of business, experiences capacity constraints or temporary facility closures.

geo_supply_chain.note: 搜尋摘要未顯示代工廠所在地（台灣/中國）具體資料，亦未讀到頁面；自有廠為麻州Lowell等美國及法國，屬搜尋摘要轉述，無逐字原文故未列 finding。

clues.claim: 10-Q FY2026：砷化鎵等關鍵材料可能因地緣政治與出口管制而短缺；自有廠位於Lowell、Ann Arbor、RTP、法國Limeil-Brévannes
